reviews.title: inexpensive but powerful
reviews.comment: For a time I looked down on Pentium processors as weak but I will no more.  While this Pentium should not be confused with an i7 or i9, it has nicely given new speed to my NAS.  Given the price tag, this is a great buy in terms of value for the money.
reviews.author: Daniel C
